results.evidence: No production crawler request logs are connected. The config-driven evaluator returns SKIP_NO_DATA rather than deriving a waste ratio from robots policy. Synthetic coverage proves measured waste above thresholds.crawlWasteWarnPct produces WARN.
Discovery lag requires paired publication and discovery timestamps. Neither production crawl logs nor GSC discovery data are connected, so median discovery lag is not fabricated.

Crawler user-agent text alone never establishes identity. Googlebot requires provider-owned reverse DNS plus forward-confirmation to the original IP. OAI-SearchBot/OAI-AdsBot and Perplexity crawler families require the source IP to match a supplied current official provider manifest identified by its governed source URL. Unsupported UA-only GPTBot/ClaudeBot observations remain UNVERIFIED. Spoofed Googlebot negative fixture is rejected.
